items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Hepburn, Richard Barthelmus, (PHONETIC), these are all people that you wouldn't really know about.

ctx.x: Who else was in Cee Pee C.P. Johnson's band? (inaudible)?
Jack MacVea (PHONETIC) was a baritone saxophone player. That's the guy that wrote "Open the Door, Richard."
(Inaudible). I remember that; that was in the '40s.
